release_id.description: Release identity derived from returned resources; null when unknown, including all-empty discovery or county selections. No historical snapshot is implied. Provenance success matches the requested expected_release_id.

response_at.description: API response timestamp, not source freshness or source retrieval time. For county profiles this is the last selection page response timestamp; an unknown/null timestamp supplies no freshness evidence.

next_page_token.description: Opaque continuation for this bounded page; null means no further page is advertised for this query. Successful execution alone does not mean all pages have been retrieved. Preserve query and release when continuing. Supply as page_token for indicator continuation.

measure_page_tokens.description: Map of indicator IDs to advertised measure continuations. Continue each entry with indicator_id and measure_page_token. An empty map advertises no additional measure pages for these indicators; also inspect the indicator next_page_token before considering discovery exhausted.
